messages:
pat: Cutting RC from release/1.15.x -> 1.15.0-rc1. Contains config-driven rate limiter + telemetry sidecar. Need quick QA signoff and infra pin. Target promo window 09:30 UTC. @mina-qa can you run smoke and short perf sweep?

mina-qa: starting smoke now. will check token flows, streaming, and sidecar metrics.

zach-infra: pre-pulling sidecar to nodes and will kv-warm. Also adding a temporary pod memory bump for warmups.

deploy-bot: [build pinned] artifact=redwood-core:1.15.0-rc1 sha=sha256:ff7788 scheduled_promo=2026-04-25T09:30:00Z status=queued notes="rate-limiter v3 + metrics sidecar"

mina-qa: smoke results: core services ok, sidecar reporting mismatched metric labels on a subset (client_id vs client) causing a mapping warning but not fatal. snippet:
```
2026-04-25T08:50:12Z sidecar.metrics WARN label_mismatch: expected=client got=client_id
2026-04-25T08:50:13Z redwood-core INFO health=passing
```

pat: label mismatch annoying but not blocking provided the mapping falls back. Zach, can infra add a transient label-mapping shim in the sidecar config for canary?

zach-infra: yes I can patch config at deploy time for canary to accept both labels. Will add mapping and re-run a quick smoke.

mina-qa: re-smoke after mapping applied: warnings cleared, metrics flowing, no 5xx. recommend proceed.

pat: product signoff from me. Scheduling promo at 09:30 UTC. Add guardrail: auto-rollback if service.5xx > 0.5% for 2m or if sidecar_liveness fails.

deploy-bot: [promo scheduled] artifact=redwood-core:1.15.0-rc1 promo_time=2026-04-25T09:30:00Z steps=[canary(10%)->bump(30%)->full(100%)] rollback_command=`deployctl rollback --to=stable --from=1.15.0-rc1` checks=[service.5xx>0.5%->auto-rollback, sidecar_liveness->must_pass]

oncall-ryan: I'll be on-call for the window. Pager set to release-sheriff.

zach-infra: kv-warm and pre-pulls done. circuit-breakers set.

deploy-bot: [promo started] step=canary target=10% started_at=2026-04-25T09:30:05Z

deploy-bot: [canary update] 10% steady 90s, errors=0, sidecar_liveness=OK, p95=145ms

mina-qa: seeing a small error cluster on an auth downstream path, ~0.4% 5xx for a brief period correlated with a separate deploy in that service.

pat: pause bump to 30%. Hold at 10% until auth downstream stabilizes. Do not rollback yet.

deploy-bot: [promo paused] reason="downstream auth deploy" paused_at=2026-04-25T09:31:40Z

oncall-ryan: monitoring auth upstream; alerts show rolling restarts completed, error rate dropping.

mina-qa: re-checking canary: errors down to 0.05%, p95 stable.

deploy-bot: [canary resume] resumed_at=2026-04-25T09:35:20Z continuing to bump to 30%

deploy-bot: [promo update] step=bump target=30% started_at=2026-04-25T09:36:10Z 30% steady 1m, errors=0.03%, p95=150ms

pat: proceeding to full per plan.

deploy-bot: [promo update] step=full target=100% started_at=2026-04-25T09:42:00Z full steady, errors=0.02%, p95=152ms

oncall-ryan: post-deploy checks ok. Will monitor for 30m and escalate if thresholds crossed.

pat: publishing release notes: "1.15.0-rc1: rate-limiter v3, metrics sidecar, temporary label mapping applied for metrics compatibility." Closing thread; if regressions appear, run rollback_command and open incident. Thanks team. :tada:

mina-qa: ack and thanks everyone.
